title: Mandate 75 pure Apache-2.0 cloud raw-source discovery, smart routing, one-step pickup, and offline release-qualify verify-only fix
goal: Implement Mandate 75 pure Apache-2.0 compliance and autonomous cloud raw-source pickup in xtask/src/harvest.rs (`local-harvest route`, `local-harvest pickup`, `local-harvest raw-features`, strict pure Apache-2.0 / dual-elected Apache-2.0 license gate with zero MIT/BSD fallback, Core 5-pillar vs Commercial Apps boundary routing, and §4(a)-(d) provenance artifacts), add end-to-end bare-Git cloud harvest integration tests in tests/pure_apache2_cloud_harvest.rs, and fix `release-qualify --verify-only` in local offline repositories without configured Git remotes so distilled_release_promotion passes 10/10.
limitations: SPDX and license-body checks enforce deterministic automated screening and are not legal counsel.
